abstract: To evaluate the potential effect of patient selection on chemotherapy trials for patients with advanced germ cell tumors (GCT), four sets of eligibility criteria for poor risk trials were compared in 118 patients. A significant difference was found in the number of patients designated poor risk by the various criteria (P less than .005). Disagreement in the risk assignment by the various selection criteria was seen in 44% of patients. Initial complete response (CR) rates in patients designated poor risk by the various criteria ranged from 38% to 62%. Initial CR rates as high as 94% were seen in patients considered to be poor risk by one set of criteria, but good risk by another. Substantial differences in sensitivity, specificity, overall predictive value, and survival distributions were observed for the various selection criteria. Randomized trials will be necessary to reduce the influence of eligibility criteria on trial outcome and conclusions.
abstract_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)に対する化学療法試験において、患者選択が試験結果に与える影響を評価するため、4種類の「予後不良」試験適格基準を118例の患者で比較した。様々な基準で予後不良と判定された患者数には有意差が認められた(P<.005)。基準間で危険度判定が一致しなかった患者は44%であった。様々な基準で予後不良とされた患者の初回完全奏効(CR)率は38%から62%の範囲であった。ある基準では予後不良、別の基準では予後良好とされた患者において、初回CR率が94%に達する例も見られた。各選択基準の感度、特異度、総合的予測価値、生存曲線には大きな差が認められた。試験結果や結論に対する適格基準の影響を減らすには、無作為化試験が必要である。
